title: TCG: Twilight Masquerade
description: Ogerpon and the Loyal Three take the stage!

questions.question: Which Pokémon is the central focus of Twilight Masquerade?
questions.explanation: Ogerpon from The Teal Mask DLC is the star, with all four mask forms featured.

questions.question: All four of Ogerpon's mask forms appear as ex cards in this set.
questions.explanation: Teal, Wellspring, Hearthflame, and Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon ex all debut here.

questions.question: Which of the Loyal Three is NOT in Twilight Masquerade?

options.text: All three are in the set

questions.explanation: Okidogi, Munkidori, and Fezandipiti — the Loyal Three — all appear as ex cards.

questions.question: Greninja ex from Twilight Masquerade became a top-tier deck.
questions.explanation: Greninja ex's Shinobi Blade ability and Stage 2 line led to multiple regional wins.

questions.question: Which Special Illustration Rare became a fan favorite?
questions.explanation: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex's SIR is among the most popular pulls from the set.

questions.question: How many cards does Twilight Masquerade contain?
questions.explanation: Twilight Masquerade has 226 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: Carmine debuts as a Supporter card in Twilight Masquerade.
questions.explanation: Carmine, a character from The Teal Mask DLC, debuts as a Supporter in this set.

questions.question: Which mechanic continues to appear in Twilight Masquerade?
questions.explanation: ACE SPEC cards continue from Temporal Forces with new entries in TWM.

questions.question: Twilight Masquerade is the sixth main SV expansion.
questions.explanation: It is the 6th main set in the Scarlet & Violet era.
